description_en: Queries a created DHCP options set by calling the GetDhcpOptionsSet operation

kebab_example: aliyun vpc get-dhcp-options-set --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --dhcp-options-set-id dopt-o6w0df4epg9zo8isy0000 --region cn-hangzhou
